purpose: Teach: 寸法/鉢/悩ま/こぼし/とかし/しり/ふる/低かっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の着物、寸法、なかなか合わなくなったな、私。
lines.en: My old kimonos don't fit quite right anymore.
lines.style: Slow, gentle observation. A small sigh underneath. Looking at something distant. The tone of someone noticing his own slow changes without complaint.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。窓辺の鉢植え、水、忘れずにあげましょうね。
lines.en: The potted plant by the window needs water. Don't forget.
lines.style: Soft but practical. A small reminder wrapped in tenderness. Steady voice, the kind that comes from long habit of tending things.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 年金のこと、最近、私を悩ますんだよ。
lines.en: The pension stuff has been weighing on me lately.
lines.style: Measured, turning something over in his mind. Not complaining — thinking aloud to someone who understands. Quiet gravity beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お茶、震えで、こぼしちゃったわ、さっき。
lines.en: I spilled my tea earlier. My hands were shaking.
lines.style: Wry acceptance. A small self-aware laugh in the tone. Not pitying herself, just noticing. Matter-of-fact delivery with a thread of dark humor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫が、髪をとかしてくれて、嬉しかったな、先週。
lines.en: Last week our grandchild combed my hair for me. That made me happy.
lines.style: Warm memory surfacing. Voice softens and steadies at once. The pleasure of being tended to. A small pause before 'happy' — letting the moment settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫と、しりとり、毎週日曜の楽しみよ。
lines.en: Word-chain games with our grandchild every Sunday — that's what I look forward to.
lines.style: Bright affection. A lift in the voice. The tone of someone naming something small and certain that matters deeply. Unhurried, savoring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 雨がふる前に、洗濯物、取り込みましょう、お母さん。
lines.en: We should bring in the laundry before the rain comes.
lines.style: Gentle directive. Practical but not rushed. The tone of someone noticing the sky and speaking from long experience. Thoughtful, not commanding.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の私の身長、確かに、低かったわね、今より。
lines.en: I was shorter when I was younger. Much shorter than I am now.
lines.style: Wistful reflection, tinged with light bewilderment. Speaking something half-remembered, half-discovered. Trailing off slightly — the small wonder of having changed.
